description: The machine the claimed chip sits in: chassis plus primary display. Emits no profile field; it is a coherence selector. panel, media_topology and battery are conditioned on it so a single draw decides the machine and the three surfaces cannot contradict each other. Servability is `none` and every option set is non-empty, so this key is always resolved, which is why axes may safely be conditioned on it (an axis conditioned on a filterable axis such as `panel` would hit the LOG(FATAL) unresolved-parent path when the filter empties it).
label: machine_class

options.note: AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED: a machine class, i.e. the chassis and attached display the claimed chip was actually sold in. This axis emits NO profile field. It exists so that panel, media_topology and battery are drawn from one machine rather than three independent ones, which is what produced draws like an Apple M4 Max in a MacBook Air with a Studio Display topology.
options.source: resources/profiles/dispersion/gpu_identity.json (the chip) plus the shipping machines that chip was sold in; Apple M1 shipped in this machine class
